I am feeling overwhelmed and I keep crying uncontrollably .   I do not know why . I am emotional for no discernable reason .    I feel like a burden because I am so effusively sad and anxious .   I cannot contain it and am crying in front of others and am unable to stop .

I am looking forward to being able to see my close friend .   I am working on a crochet project that is a surprise for a different close friend .   These things are lifting my mood slightly .   However , I still feel overwhelmed and anxious , although that is covered up by a general feeling of being numb .

I am feeling overstimulated and overwhelmed .   As long as I am alone and nothing is happening , I am okay , but it is fragile .   When anyone talks to me it is too much and I get angry at the sound .   Even the tv on as background noise is too much , but silence is also irritating .   I am crocheting and I am not necessarily enjoying it but it is keeping my mood neutral as opposed to anxious or panicked .

I feel fragile again - as in , so long as I am by myself with no outside stumuli I am numb or even okay .   Positive stimuli is able to affect me somewhat .   I am still overly emotional about small things and very easily made irritable or sad .

I feel very exhausted .   I am hyper focused on crocheting but I am running out of steam .   I am not interested in anything other than crocheting , so I feel anxious about running out of energy .   I might burn myself out crocheting , or I might save my energy and become frustrated due to boredom .
Triggered (PTSD) , Triggered (eating disotder) , Anxious , Nauseous , Drained

I mostly feel physically and emotionally exhausted .   I have been unable to sleep well .   I do not function well at all when I haven ' t slept well .   I mostly feel numb and lonely , but would feel irritable around people or with any kind of noise . I do not feel capable of doing anything .

I am feeling very anxious and overwhelmed .   I keep crying for no apparent reason .   I feel very scared and small .   I feel vulnerable and depressed .   I ' m having frequent panic attacks .   I feel lonely despite having social interactions .

I am feeling drained and irritable .   I am still very exhausted and I am bored because I am too tired to do anything .   I am irritable perhaps because I am bored , or perhaps because I am still so tired .   I am still having a lot of brain fog and I feel slow .

I am exhausted .   I have slept enough but I still feel emotionally drained and tired .   I don ' t know what my issue is at this point .   I feel like since I finally slept , I should be less tired , but I guess life is a never-ending cycle of exhaustion

I feel overwhelmed .   I feel depressed .   I feel hopeless .   I keep crying and I do not know why I am crying .   I feel scared . I do not feel capable of doing much .   I am less tired than I have been but I feel too overwhelmed to function anyhow .

I keep having scary intrusive thoughts of horrible things happening .   I am overwhelmed .   I am crying a lot .   I am tired and scared .   I feel depressed and hopeless .   I feel unsafe and insecure .   I just want things to feel better and they never do .

I am feeling upset and sad and lonely .   I thought I was known by a person close to me , and now I feel as if they never truly knew me and it feels like a rejection .   How can I still be loved if they never actually knew me ?   You can learn who I am and learn to love that person , but currently , the idea of me is loved because they don ' t actually know me .   I feel scared and I want to be loved for me .
